[gold]Load[/gold] a card from your hand.

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ROLLING_BARRAGE.descr:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each stack of your [gold]temporary Powers[/gold].

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_CALAMITY_PURIFICATION:
All your [gold]Status[/gold] and [gold]Curse[/gold] cards are [gold]Sealed[/gold].
Whenever you draw a [gold]Sealed[/gold] card, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_EVENING_CALM.title: Evening Calm

After your turn ends, draw that many cards.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FAR_SIGHT.title: Far Sight
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FAR_SIGHT.description:
Draw X cards.
Reduce their Energy costs by X this turn.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FIERCE_AS_FIRE.title: Fierce as Fire
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FIERCE_AS_FIRE.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

Costs 1 less Energy for each Orb residing in this card.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_OFUDA.title: Ofuda
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_OFUDA.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Apply [gold]Sealed[/gold] to a card in your hand.

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_OPENING_SALVO.title: Opening Salvo

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SACRED_TREE.title: Sacred Tree

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SHELL_SELECTION.descr:

This card also hosts the chosen Orb.|}
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SOUL_WELCOMING.title: Soul Welcoming
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_STEADFAST_GUARD.title: Steadfast Guard
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SYMPATHETIC_DETONATIO:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
This turn, whenever this enemy takes damage, deal 50% of that damage to all other enemies.

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_WIND_CYCLE.descriptio: Draw until the cards in your hand host at least {Orbs:diff()} Orbs.

Repeatedly trigger your [gold]Plating[/gold] until you have none.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ARMORED_REFIT.title: Armored Refit
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ARMORED_REFIT.descrip: Before your turn starts, convert all your [gold]Block[/gold] into [gold]Plating[/gold] for that turn.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_BATTLE_DISPOSITION.se: Drag cards to reorder, or select two cards in sequence to swap their positions.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_CLIMB_MOUNT_NIITAKA.d:

NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_CONCENTRATED_FIRE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain [gold]Focus[/gold] equal to your stacks of {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]temporary Powers[/gold]|temporary [gold]Focus[/gold]} this turn.

Deal X+{Damage:diff()} damage X+{Hits:diff()} times to random enemies.
When drawn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_MYRIAD_REVELATIONS.de: When making an individual [gold]Choice[/gold], you may choose multiple options.
